purpose: This table provides cleaned aircraft registration and specification data (tail number, manufacturer, model, engine type, seats, year, and speed) sourced from FAA-style registry records, intended to feed flight-analysis and fleet-reporting consumers that need to enrich flight records with aircraft attributes.
usage: Join on tailnum to enrich flight records with aircraft attributes; be aware that year is null for about 2.1% of records (70 of 3322) and speed is null for about 99.3% of records (3299 of 3322), so consumers should handle these nulls explicitly (e.g., coalesce or filter) rather than assume a value is present.
limitations: Speed is populated for only about 0.7% of rows and should not be used for aggregate speed analysis without acknowledging this sparse coverage; year has a 2.1% null rate reflecting missing manufacture dates; airbyte capture metadata columns (_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, _airbyte_meta) were dropped as they carry no business meaning and duplicate_row_rate of 0.0 means no deduplication logic was applied.
